source_title: You Thought Stephen Kalyn Was Hot in Off Campus? Wait Until You See His Sexiest Man Alive Shoot - People.com
source_excerpt:
The actor, who is ready to flex his leading man status in ‘Off Campus’ season 2, opens up about his career and love story with his fiancée, Victoria Lovatsis
Canada native Stephen Kalyn had a breakout year winning over viewers as the charming playboy Dean Di Laurentis in the hit hockey series Off Campus . But if you think he’s already scored big, he’s only getting started.
In the upcoming second season of the show, which wrapped filming just days after Kalyn’ Sexiest Man Alive shoot at a gym in Vancouver in September, he gets the leading-man treatment as the show spotlights Dean’s relationship with Allie Hayes ( Mika Abdalla ).
“Just get ready,” he teases, before quoting one of his character’s many memorable lines: “We’re going on a roller coaster.”
If Kalyn, 28, seems extra comfortable on skates, it’s because he was once an aspiring hockey player in his hometown of Markham, Ontario, Canada.
After his coach Sean Gray saw him play Danny Zuko in a school production of Grease , he told him, “You’re too pretty to be a hockey player. You should stick to acting.”
“I went, ‘Are you telling me I’m a bad hockey player?,’” he recalls. “He’s like, ‘No, no, you’re a great hockey player, but I think you’re a better actor.’”
Kalyn listened. He made his professional acting debut in the medical drama Transplant in 2020.
“That was my first role, and I was so terrified,” he says. “I had somewhat of an emotional scene, and I didn’t know. I called all my acting coaches from college, like, ‘How do I do this?’”
“It was quite the experience,” he adds. “I was super proud, and I thought I was going to be a huge star after that. It took a lot more auditions to get to this position now.”
When the Off Campus books were being adapted for TV, it was his fiancée Victoria Lovatsis who encouraged him to audition for the role of Dean.
She’d been a fan of the novels and “took a liking to Dean,” he says. “She said it’d be a character that she thinks I could play. I went in, and I auditioned for Logan at first, and I didn’t hear anything, unfortunately, but then a couple of months later, this audition came in for Dean. The rest is history.” (The role of Logan ultimately went to actor Antonio Cipriano.)
Audiences quickly came to love Dean and Allie, and Kalyn credits the “push and pull” dynamic between them for that.
“I think they’re just a fun couple, and they are comfortable sexually and also verbally,” he says. “I think it’s a fun banter between the two of them that makes it so exciting for people to watch.”
While fans got to see “a lot of that Playboy charm from Dean” in the first season, he says “there’s a lot of exploration for Dean when it comes to just growing as a human being” in season 2.
“On paper, the character can be the most typical frat boy douchebag you could imagine, but I really wanted to make him have a sensitive, sweet side that you can see,” he says. “I really liked playing the sensitive side to him, because that’s kind of like me in real life.”
Kalyn has been with his fiancée since high school, after striking up a romance at a dance.
“I was absolutely terrified to kiss her or do anything, but I think the night ended with a kiss on the cheek,” he says. “I don’t know if it was me who kissed her or if she kissed me. After that, I asked her out.”
Kalyn says Lovatsis has been with him through “all the ups and downs” as they grew from their teens to their 20s.
“She always stuck by my side,” he says. “Victoria keeps me grounded, and my family and friends.”
In fact, Kalyn says his family might be a little too blunt with him, namely his sister.
“Obviously, she’s very proud of the show, but she’ll tease me like, ‘You guys just aren’t as hot as The O.C. or One Tree Hill guys. I’m sorry,’” he says with a laugh. “I’m like, ‘Thanks a lot, Ashley. Whatever. I hope you don’t ever find me attractive in that way.’”
With Off Campus season 2 on the horizon and filming underway for his next role in The Housemaid sequel, The Housemaid’s Secret , Kalyn says he and Lovatsis are “putting a little pin on” wedding planning for now.
“It’s just been insane,” he says. “I’m very much so looking forward to the holidays and seeing my family again and all that.”
Until then, he plans on soaking in every moment of what’s been an unbelievable ride.
“It’s such a pinch me moment, everything — even coming here,” he says. “I’m just so grateful to be here in this position. It’s not easy to get that one job and for somebody to give you the thumbs up. I just want to keep working hard and continue to play interesting and fun dynamic characters in the future.”
